messages:
Lina (docs): Starting a small refresh for the HelloLabs quickstart: replace raw fetch snippets with SDK calls, unify auth env var, and add a short Docker deploy path.
Omar Ruiz: Thanks. Which env var are we standardizing on? I keep seeing REDWOOD_KEY in examples.
Lina (docs): Using REDWOOD_API_KEY going forward. I'll update all codeblocks and the curl examples to use Authorization: Bearer <token>.
Priya Desai: Can you include a minimal healthcheck example for containers? A lot of customers curl /_health.
Lina (docs): Will add a tiny /_health endpoint and a sample Dockerfile CMD + HEALTHCHECK line.
Nate (devex): Also include an SDK streaming snippet and a note on when to prefer streaming vs single-response API. A one-liner tip is enough.
Lina (docs): Draft SDK streaming snippet adding now:

```js
// Node SDK streaming (compact)
const s = await client.chat.stream({model: 'redwood-compact', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'Hello!'}]});
for await (const part of s) process.stdout.write(part.delta || '');
```

and Python generator:

```py
# Python SDK streaming
for part in client.chat.stream(model='redwood-compact', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'Hey'}]):
    print(part.delta, end='')
```

Omar Ruiz: Nice. One nit: older docs mention scope-limited keys for hosted API; that's inaccurate. Remove that paragraph or replace with "scopes are reserved for private deployments".
Lina (docs): Replaced that section and added a short troubleshooting subsection for common 401s when running docker locally (missing env var, extra quotes, firewall/NAT on linux).
DocsBot: Link check: docs/quickstart/hellolabs.md -> /api/usage/old is broken (404). Suggested replace: /api/usage/overview.
Lina (docs): Fixed link and pushed branch. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/629>
QA-bot: Automated sample runner: node samples/hello-labs.js -> failed due to old header X-API-KEY in sample. See logs.
Lina (docs): Good catch; updated curl/node examples to Authorization header. Re-ran sample locally, passes now.
Priya Desai: For deploy section, can we add a brief note about Dedicated routing fallback? "If a requested model isn't deployed in your Dedicated region, traffic will route to the nearest compatible variant; pin models to avoid surprises."
Lina (docs): Added that sentence and linked to runtime routing doc.
Nate (devex): Suggest trimming examples to fit the quickstart (aim < 10 lines). Also add a one-sentence comparison: streaming = lower latency incremental tokens, non-streaming = simpler code for short outputs.
Lina (docs): Trimmed both SDK examples and added the one-line comparison. Marked PR ready for review.
Omar Ruiz: Reviewed Node snippets and Dockerfile. LGTM. One tiny change: example Docker run in docs should show `-e REDWOOD_API_KEY` (no equals) vs `-e "REDWOOD_API_KEY=..."` to avoid confusion on shells.
Lina (docs): Updated wording and examples to be explicit about both forms.
DocsBot: CI checks: markdown lint OK; sample smoke tests OK; link-check OK.
Lina (docs): Merging in ~15m. I'll post a short note in #all-hands after deploy. Thanks for the fast review! :tada:
Priya Desai: :thumbsup: I'll try the quickstart on a fresh VM and report back if anything low-level breaks.
Nate (devex): I'll prepare a micro-snippet for SDK auth rotation to include in the follow-up guide.
Lina (docs): Great — follow-up PR for auth rotation snippets welcomed.
